pages.text: Botania is the primary $(t1)Tier 1$(end) magic mod. Mana generation, magical flowers, and the Mana Pool.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Your first mana system. Manasteel is the $(t1)T1$(end) magic material ceiling. Botania's Orechid has been modified to produce Osmium and Diamond Ore (gated by available mana cost).$(br2)$(bold)Key IridescentCraft interactions:$(/bold) Botania mana tools are affected by $(thing)Faefolk$(/thing)'s Nature Magic racial (+15% effectiveness). The Lexica Botania is the in-mod documentation — read it.

$(bold)Tier gating:$(/bold) Terrasteel and Elementium are $(t3)T3$(end) materials in this pack — crafting them requires $(t3)T3$(end) to be unlocked. Manasteel and Mana Pearl are the T1–$(t2)T2$(end) ceiling.$(br2)$(bold)Gaia Guardian:$(/bold) Summoned boss, $(t3)T3$(end) content. Drops $(item)Magiblade$(/item) unique weapon (20%) and Gaia Spirit Fragments. Scales progressively.
Craft the $(bold)Lexica Botania$(/bold) for the full in-mod reference — every flower, every mana structure, every ritual. Essential reading for any Botania build.
